name: axel-memory-manager
description: Axel — portable agent intelligence: project-scoped memory tools (memory_search/fetch/store/forget), offline lexical FTS, sensitivity + retention classes, one .r8 file as the agent's entire brain.

tools.description: Search project-scoped memories in the local axel brain (offline lexical search). Returns bounded descriptors with stable IDs and short snippets — never full bodies, never secret content. Results are lower-authority recall aids.

project.description: Optional confirmation of the canonical project key. Must equal the host-derived key if provided; the model cannot select a different project.

query.description: Lexical search text. Omit to list recent memories.

since.description: RFC3339 lower bound on creation time.

until.description: RFC3339 upper bound on creation time.

tools.name: memory_search

tools.description: Fetch one memory by exact ID from the trusted project scope. Body is bounded; secret or restricted-retention bodies are withheld with a reason.

project.description: Optional confirmation of the canonical project key.

tools.name: memory_fetch

tools.description: Store a memory in the trusted project scope. Requires explicit project confirmation: pass the canonical project key in 'project' (call memory_search first to learn it, or read it from the error message). retention=never_persist is always refused.

expires_hours.description: Optional TTL in hours; the memory expires and is excluded after this.

project.description: REQUIRED explicit confirmation: the canonical project key of the trusted scope.

retention.description: Disclosure/retention class (default: standard). never_persist is refused at the persistence boundary.

sensitivity.description: secret: body never indexed, snippeted, or returned to a model.

tools.name: memory_store

tools.description: Permanently delete one memory by exact ID from the trusted project scope. Writes a tombstone: the id can never be re-inserted and never re-surfaces in search.

project.description: Optional confirmation of the canonical project key.

tools.name: memory_forget

commands.name: axel
commands.description: Manage Axel memory brain and GLiNER models.

fields.label: Min consolidation length
fields.help: Messages shorter than this byte length are skipped during consolidation.

fields.label: GLiNER metadata enrichment
fields.help: When on, runs a small CPU model to extract tags, topics, and category from each chat turn. ~165 MB model downloaded on first use; ~50 ms per turn.

fields.label: GLiNER model variant
fields.help: Model size. Small is 165 MB / ~300 MB RAM / ~50 ms; medium is 440 MB / ~600 MB / ~120 ms. Restart required after change.

fields.label: When to enrich memories
fields.help: off: never enrich. on_complete: per chat turn (live tags). on_session_end: batch at end (cheaper). First chat turn after enabling will block ~10–30 s while the model downloads.

fields.label: Recall injection before each message
fields.help: OFF by default. When on, injects a bounded, lower-authority, project-scoped memory recall block before each user message. Requires a trusted project scope.

fields.label: Boot memory injection at session start
fields.help: OFF by default. When on, injects a bounded, project-scoped memory summary at session start. Requires a trusted project scope.

fields.label: Local embedding model (semantic search)
fields.help: OFF by default; lexical FTS works fully offline without it. Even when on, the ~86 MB model is never downloaded implicitly — run the 'axel download-embeddings' command first.

fields.label: Trusted project root
fields.help: Host-owned trusted project directory for memory scoping. Memory tools fail closed when neither this nor SYNAPS_PROJECT_ROOT is set. The model can never choose or widen the project scope.
